svg.title: South Atlantic Current: one southern component band
svg.desc: Author-reported nominal200 km breadth of the band south of the Subtropical Front, Knorr1 E section, October1983. The primary front carries other SAC flow. Not total-current width, secondary-core diameter, mapped boundaries or annual range.

g.text: South Atlantic Current / southern component band
October 1983 / Knorr section k at 1 E
Author-reported band breadth / whole-current width unknown
Southern band carries part of SAC flow; primary front carries other flow.
Relative geostrophy: sigma4 = 45.87 kg/m3; reference 3470-3560 m.
Upper 1,000 m is transport context; width evaluation depth unknown.
Primary-front station bracket and secondary-core location are not edges.
No total width, core diameter, mapped band, seasonal range or width error.
Source: Stramma and Peterson (1990), p854; Tables1/2(k), Figure5.
Independent OSW graphic. Original source curves and edge positions not digitized.
